name: Brimstone Demon
description: a hunched brimstone demon of the Cracked Road, born out of a crack in the black rock: heavy body of cracked black basalt with molten orange light glowing through every seam, thick stony shoulders, short curved horns of charred stone, small burning ember eyes, a wide jaw with a furnace glow inside, long arms ending in blunt rock claws, flakes of rock and sulfur-yellow dust falling off it

poses.stand: standing hunched on both feet, claws hanging low, the glow in its jaw smouldering
poses.breath: leaning forward with its jaw wide open, a short cone of orange fire roaring out of its mouth to the right
poses.dead: collapsed on the ground, split into cooling pieces of black rock with the glow gone out of the seams

idle.action: breathes heavily in place, shoulders rising and falling, the glowing seams pulsing brighter and dimmer

attack.action: rears back, then lunges its head forward and breathes a short burst of fire to the right

hurt.action: is struck, a chip of rock flies off its shoulder, it staggers back and recovers

die.action: cracks apart along its glowing seams and crumbles into dark rock as the light goes out
